policy: A start row may be unpaired only for a documented fault injection. A run_id may repeat only when a whole batch had to be re-run after a defect: the LAST attempt for a run_id is the delivered one, earlier attempts are superseded and kept. Every repeated id is listed here; verify_delivery.py fails on any repetition that is not listed.

unpaired_start.reason: end-row write failure injection; entry.run replaced by a stub, no rank model and no GLNS call

superseded_batches.INIT/EVENT attempts 1-3: the closed loop was re-run after three defects (sparse-case free set, event_state coordinate types, N2 obstacle rule); all earlier attempts stay in the ledger

known_config_collision.detail: the first attempt named both the cap=2 and the cap=2*|Q| configuration :capmax when |Q|=1, so that run id repeats; the V3 re-run names them by slot (cap2 / capmax) and is the delivered one.
known_config_collision.requirement: both configurations stay registered; the delivered artifacts come from V3
